title: Rethinking End-to-End Evaluation of Decomposable Tasks: A Case Study on Spoken Language Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the Word Error Rate (WER) of the Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) system on audio from native English speakers versus speakers whose first language is not English.

Evaluating model generalizability across diverse speaker backgrounds by creating test splits that minimize the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence of discrete speaker demographic distributions (including age, gender, native language, and English fluency) between the training and test sets.
